_note: 學習路徑內容建置第8批 #6／6：分裂句/強調句 It-cleft（eng.t_adv.special.cleft-it，學測級／高階）。結構＝It ＋ is/was ＋ 被強調的部分 ＋ that/who ＋ 其餘。強調主詞/受詞用 who(人)/that，強調時間用 that。is/was 配合時間。高階特別防第二正解：用結構誘答（缺 who/that、語序錯、which 指人）鎖唯一正解，刻意避開 is/was 口語兩可（P1/P3/P5 不考 is vs was；P4 的 is/was 因與『last summer』時間明顯不符而唯一）。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix clf_）。

units.title_zh: 分裂句／強調句（It is／was X that…）
units.can_do: 我能用 It ＋ is／was ＋ 被強調的部分 ＋ that／who ＋ 其餘，造出強調句，把句中某個部分（人、事物、時間）特別點出來；知道強調人用 who 或 that、強調事物/時間用 that，連接詞 that／who 不可省略，is／was 配合時間。
units.situation_group: 特殊句型 Emphasis: the it-cleft
units.subject: eng

claims.text: An it-cleft emphasizes one part of a sentence with the frame 'It + is/was + emphasized part + that/who + the rest': 'It was Tom who broke the window'.
claims.verification_ref: It ＋ is/was ＋ 強調部分 ＋ that/who ＋ 其餘；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Use 'who' (or 'that') for people and 'that' for things or time in the cleft: 'It was John who/that we invited'; 'It was the noise that woke me'.
claims.verification_ref: 人用 who/that、事物/時間用 that；which 不用於人；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The verb 'is/was' matches the time of the action: use 'was' for a past action: 'It was last year that we moved here'.
claims.verification_ref: is/was 配合動作時間（過去用 was）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The connector 'that' or 'who' cannot be dropped in an it-cleft: say 'It was Lucy who found the keys', not 'It was Lucy found the keys'.
claims.verification_ref: 連接詞 that/who 不可省略；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 強調句（分裂句）把句中想特別點出的部分挪到 It is／was 後面。結構：It ＋ is／was ＋ 被強調的部分 ＋ that／who ＋ 其餘。例如把 Tom broke the window 的 Tom 強調：It was Tom who broke the window（是湯姆打破了窗戶）。
It was my grandmother who taught me how to cook.
teach.zh_hint: 是我奶奶教我怎麼做菜的。強調人 my grandmother，用 who。

teach.body: 強調「人」用 who 或 that；強調「事物」或「時間」用 that。連接詞 that／who 不能省略：要說 It was Lucy who found the keys，不能說 ×It was Lucy found the keys。注意 which 不用在人。
It was this old song that made everyone start to dance.
teach.zh_hint: 是這首老歌讓大家開始跳舞的。強調事物 this old song，用 that。

teach.body: 也可以強調「時間」：It was last year that we moved to this city（我們是去年搬到這座城市的）。開頭的 is／was 要配合動作的時間——過去的事用 was。
It was last summer that we traveled to Japan together.
teach.zh_hint: 我們是去年夏天一起去日本的。強調時間 last summer，用 was ＋ that。

practice.stem: 選出正確的強調句開頭：____ my brother that broke the window, not me.（是我弟弟打破窗戶的，不是我）

distractor_rationales.He was: 強調句開頭固定用 It，不是 He（×He was my brother that broke…）；正確是 It was。
distractor_rationales.That was: 強調句的框架是 It ＋ was… ＋ that，開頭用 It 不用 That（×That was… that 重複又不成句）。
distractor_rationales.There was: There was 是『有…存在』，不是強調句；強調句開頭用 It was。

practice.feedback: 強調句開頭固定是 It ＋ was：It was my brother that broke the window。

practice.stem: 填入正確的連接詞：It was John ____ we invited to the party, not Peter.（我們邀請去派對的人是約翰，不是彼得）

distractor_rationales.which: which 用在事物，不用在人；強調的人 John 用 who（或 that）。
distractor_rationales.what: 強調句不用 what 當連接詞（×It was John what…）；人用 who。
distractor_rationales.whose: whose 表『誰的』（所有），這裡要的是連接詞；強調人用 who。

practice.feedback: 強調的是人 John，用 who（或 that）：It was John who we invited。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句正確地強調 Lucy found the keys 裡的 Lucy？
practice.answer: It was Lucy who found the keys.
options: It was Lucy who found the keys.
It was Lucy found the keys.
It was Lucy which found the keys.
It Lucy was who found the keys.

少了連接詞 who/that（×It was Lucy found…）；強調句的 that/who 不能省略。
which 不用在人；強調人 Lucy 要用 who（或 that）。
語序錯了；正確是 It ＋ was ＋ Lucy ＋ who…，不是 It Lucy was…。

practice.feedback: It ＋ was ＋ Lucy ＋ who ＋ 其餘，連接詞不可省：It was Lucy who found the keys。

practice.stem: 選出正確的強調句開頭（強調時間）：____ last summer that we visited Japan, not this year.（我們是去年夏天去日本的，不是今年）

distractor_rationales.It is: 動作在過去（last summer、visited），開頭的 be 動詞要用過去式 was，不是 is。
distractor_rationales.We were: 強調句開頭固定用 It，不是 We；而且 We were… that 不成句。正確是 It was。
distractor_rationales.There was: There was 是『有…存在』，不是強調句；強調時間用 It was last summer that。

practice.feedback: 強調過去的時間用 It was… that：It was last summer that we visited Japan。

practice.stem: 填入正確的連接詞：It was the loud noise ____ woke me up in the middle of the night.（是那巨大的聲響在半夜把我吵醒的）

distractor_rationales.who: who 用在人；the loud noise 是事物，用 that。
distractor_rationales.what: 強調句不用 what 當連接詞（×the noise what woke me）；事物用 that。
distractor_rationales.where: where 用在地方；這裡強調的是事物 the loud noise，用 that。

practice.feedback: 強調的是事物 the loud noise，用 that：It was the loud noise that woke me up。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: It was my best friend who gave me this book, and it was last summer that I read it.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：兩個強調句 It was… who（強調人）和 it was… that（強調時間）有沒有寫對、連接詞 who／that 有沒有漏，best friend／this book／last summer 有沒有漏，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。被強調的部分（you／that small town）稍加重，It was 輕讀帶出，句尾下收。

lines.text: It was you who helped me when I needed it most.
lines.intonation: you 加重、who helped 連讀、句尾下收

lines.text: It was in that small town that I grew up.
lines.intonation: that small town 稍加重、句尾下收
